# Roedy Rustam — AI Systems & Agentic Developer × Agro-Tech Sociopreneur
> Portfolio of Roedy Rustam, an AI Systems Architect, Model Context Protocol (MCP) developer, and Agro-Industrial consultant building autonomous agent workflows, modern edge applications, and digital tools for the coffee supply chain and village cooperatives (BUMDes) in Sulawesi, Indonesia.
> Full comprehensive AI documentation available at: https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/llms-full.txt

- [Home -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/]: Dual-engine portfolio featuring autonomous agent status, interactive MCP tool console, featured digital projects, services, and impact timeline.
- [About -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/about]: Professional background combining AI engineering, agentic architecture, Industrial Engineering background, and BNSP Agro certification.
- [Journey -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/journey]: Historical timeline from community networks (Jirak Celebes, JRKI) to modern Agentic AI workflows and Sehati Kopi Indonesia.
- [Experience -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/experience]: Fullstack AI systems development, Model Context Protocol integration, rural economic consulting, and software architecture.
- [Impact -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/impact]: Measurable social, technological, and agricultural impact across Sulawesi, Indonesia.
- [Contact -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/contact]: Channels for AI consulting, agentic tool development, speaking engagements, and agro-digital collaborations.

## Case Studies & Flagship Projects
- [AgroAgent MCP Server -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/agroagent-mcp]: An enterprise-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP v1.x) server connecting LLM agents to coffee inventory, farm telemetry, and supply chain ERP APIs.
- [Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestrator -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/agent-swarm]: An autonomous multi-agent pipeline coordinating quality inspection, SCA cupping analysis, and logistics routing.
- [Beanhub -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/beanhub]: A digital coffee supply chain platform connecting farmers to roasteries in Barru, Toraja, and Sinjai.
- [CuppingNotes -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/cuppingnotes]: A mobile-first SCA coffee cupping app for quality control, featuring an interactive flavor wheel and AI-assisted profile extraction.
- [Kafeya POS -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/kafeya]: An accounting and point of sale tool built specifically for small coffee shop owners (UMKM).
- [Pandu Desa 4.0 -> https://roedyrustam.pages.dev/projects/pandudesa]: A digital transformation initiative for village governance, economy mapping, and digital literacy.

## Open Source & GitHub Ecosystem (https://github.com/roedyrustam)
- [vibes-plug -> https://github.com/roedyrustam/vibes-plug]: 73★, 18 forks, published npm package (`vibes-plug`). Universal Skill AI Agent Swarm Architecture for Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf enabling Vibe Coding 2.0 with zero tech debt.
- [sinapsai -> https://github.com/roedyrustam/sinapsai]: In-process AI Gateway & Control Plane with Circuit Breaker, Automatic Failover, and Unified LLM API for Node.js & TypeScript.
- [doku-gemini-mcp -> https://github.com/roedyrustam/doku-gemini-mcp]: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server connecting Gemini & Antigravity agents to DOKU Payment Gateway (VA, QRIS, SNAP BI).
- [API-Wilayah-2024 -> https://github.com/roedyrustam/API-Wilayah-2024]: 21★, 10 forks. Indonesian administrative geographic hierarchy data and open REST API for village-level spatial queries.
- [macli & multi_agent_cli -> https://github.com/roedyrustam/macli]: Autonomous multi-agent CLI tooling and execution runtime.

## Core Competencies & Tech Stack
- AI & Agentic Systems: Model Context Protocol (MCP v1.x), Multi-Agent Swarms, Tool Calling, Structured Outputs, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, Context Window Engineering.
- Fullstack & Edge: React 19, TanStack Start (SSR), TanStack Router, TypeScript 5.8+, Tailwind CSS v4, Cloudflare Pages/Workers.
- Agro & Industry: Agro-Industrial Production Planning (BNSP Certified), Coffee Supply Chain Management, SCA Cupping Protocol, Village Cooperative (BUMDes) Digitalization.

- Founded Sehati Kopi Indonesia in 2025 to manage coffee operations and digital supply logistics.
- Open Source author of `vibes-plug` (73★, npm) and `API-Wilayah-2024` (21★).
- GitHub Profile: https://github.com/roedyrustam with active agentic and AI infrastructure repositories.
